decisions.support_explanation: The original definition states repeated cessation and commencing of breathing disrupting sleep; no unsupported cause is added.
The cited subclass edge is incoming to the focal class, not evidence of the focal class having the claimed superclass.
The opaque child IRIs lack labels. The proposed named subtypes cannot be recovered from these citations, and the draft also confuses mixed and central sleep-apnea identities.
